{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length per species, dropping NA values
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print the means for verification
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Return the species name
highest_mean_species"}
